name: LED Strip Lights
description: High-density flexible LED strip reels, vibrant RGB lighting systems, and precision extruded aluminum profiles engineered for seamless cove, cabinet, and ceiling illumination.

name: LED Panel Lights
description: Premium architectural spotlights including KK anti-glare recessed fixtures, AURA 6W slim downlights, and 20W shutter spotlights engineered for optical precision.

name: LED Street Lights
description: Rugged commercial street lighting, 150W high-efficiency roadway fixtures, 3-meter Y-shaped modern landscape garden poles, and KK heavy-duty exterior floodlights.

name: Electrical Accessories
description: STAR Silver luxury modular faceplates, Volt Grey designer switches, miniature circuit breakers (MCBs), Hawud distribution boards, and heavy-duty flush back boxes.

name: Cables & Wires
description: Multi-gauge pure copper insulated power cables (2x1.5 to 3x6), high-speed Cat6 UTP networking cables, and low-loss satellite television coaxial lines.

name: KK Spot Lights
description: Architectural KK recessed ceiling spotlights, deep-recessed anti-glare downlights, and satin silver aluminum fixtures engineered for modern gypsum ceilings.
